states.meaning: Shown, left empty (only possible when not required).
Its page was reached, but its show-if hid it.
The flow never got to its page.

missingValues.csv: Empty value cell plus the <var>__state column. No numeric missing codes (such as -99) are ever written.
missingValues.json: value null plus state per answer.

saveMode.implications: Answers were saved to the server on every page change. Partial sessions exist on the server, so drop-outs are visible to the researcher, but this export holds only submitted responses.

metaColumns.meaning: Published survey version the response belongs to (semantics §9).
Checksum of that version's survey document.
Checksum of the runtime plan the participant's browser ran.
How conditions were assigned: server (our server, at session start), seeded (the engine drew at least one condition from the session seed), or limesurvey-native.
Session seed (positive integer, semantics §7); reproduces every order.
Submission accepted by the server, UTC, ISO 8601.

true if the server accepted the submit after the session had expired (its quota holds were released or its resume link had expired); a late response is not counted toward quotas (semantics S-2). Set by the server, never by the browser.
true if the response was submitted after the survey was closed; empty if not known.
End outcome reached (e.g. complete); empty if none was recorded.
